Cybercrime Insurance

Cyberattacks are on the rise, and hackers are now targeting businesses of all sizes—not just large enterprises. From phishing scams to ransomware, cybercrime is costing businesses millions in lost revenue, legal fees, and reputational damage.

This is why Cyber Insurance is important.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Cyber Insurance that provides coverage for both first-party and third-party losses.

• First-Party Coverage
o Network repair due to cyber-attack
o Data loss and system storage
o Business interruption
o Crisis management
o Public relations expenses and notification expense
o Cyber Extortion

• Third-Party Coverage
o Defense cost and legal liability
o Claims arising from negligent transmission of virus to third party who used the company's website for business transaction

What is the information needed for Cyber Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Nature of Business
• Location
• Geographic Exposure
• Current Security & Data Protection Measures
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
